notes: Typed trims now do what you typed, and asking how to remove the “Made with Crisp” mark opens the unlock window with the Black Friday price, its end date and the 30-day refund. The small mark on free video exports now shows the web address, crispvideo.app/w. Asking for the first 15 seconds of a long clip right after its preview appears always starts the render, and a folder Crisp can’t write into gets one plain sentence about what to do.
